facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog post 'Using visual hierarchy to optimize your ads' was published on 2020-03-10.
The article states that people generally read text from the top left to right, then bottom left to right, in a 'Z' pattern.
facts.quote: Generally, people read text from the top left to right, and then bottom left to right—in a “Z” pattern.

facts.fact: The article states that people read bigger text first, and that this can override normal reading patterns.
facts.quote: People read text that is bigger first. It is interesting to note that this can override normal reading patterns.

facts.fact: The article's example clothing ad (goal: engagement) includes copy referring to 25% off.
facts.quote: you may have lost their attention before they get to the line about 25% off

facts.fact: The article recommends the following content viewing order for the example clothing ad: image, tagline (value proposition), logo, additional information, then CTA.
